SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md_substrate.pref_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  md_parent.pref_name AS parent_compound_name,
  met.met_conversion,
  met.pathway_key,
  met.organism,
  met.enzyme_name
FROM metabolism met
JOIN compound_records cr_substrate ON met.substrate_record_id = cr_substrate.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_substrate ON cr_substrate.molregno = md_substrate.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md_substrate.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON md_substrate.molregno = mh.molregno
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_parent ON mh.parent_molregno = md_parent.molregno
WHERE met.enzyme_name = 'CYP2D6'
LIMIT 200
